comparison_scope: Default-disabled rebuild parity against1191. Optional fixed-bed support uses the same existing Metal contact operator; no reference hip-capsule flag. All simulation updates remain GPU-owned.
predictions_before_run: Without the contoured-bed option, accepted coupled state and captures should be exactly equal to1191.
The fixed source-derived support can reduce settling by real unilateral normal/friction contact; no guaranteed clearance or physiological outcome is assumed.
Per-contact world normals must reconstruct force and momentum from accepted GPU state; normals never come from a CPU physical update.
qualification: Bounded engineering evaluation; no long-run or clinical acceptance from this run.
